scenario_title: Active L2 participation in teacher-centered CLIL lesson
minimal_context: The student is asked to explain an academic concept in English during a Grade 10 CLIL lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I have just spent some time explaining the three main stages of the water cycle. Now, I want you to explain the first stage, evaporation, in your own words.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Um... yes. The water... it gets hot.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What else can you tell me about it?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Ah... the sun... the sun makes the water... um... change.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: So... um... it... the water is... ah... it becomes... um... gas. And... ah... it... it goes up. That's... um... all.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: I have just spent some time explaining the three main stages of the water cycle. Now, I want you to explain the first stage, evaporation, in your own words.

STUDENT: Um... yes. The water... it gets hot.

TUTOR: What else can you tell me about it?

STUDENT: Ah... the sun... the sun makes the water... um... change.

TUTOR: Please continue.

STUDENT: So... um... it... the water is... ah... it becomes... um... gas. And... ah... it... it goes up. That's... um... all.

task.content: Listening to academic content delivered in English

context.social_setting: Very teacher-centered lessons where teacher talk occupied over 95% of the interaction time, and the teachers on average held the floor for over 35 seconds before distributing the turn to students

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When students mostly spoke in English during longer student turns
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Student turns consisted of quite a lot of fillers, pauses and false starts, and were shorter in actual richness in the content
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Could understand the academic content delivered in English, though some may not be able to respond or participate in interaction actively

behavior_patterns.condition: When expected to participate in interaction actively
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: May not be able to respond or participate in interaction actively
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Understand the academic content delivered in English
